children: Chinese electric vehicle maker Li Auto
will invest 2.65 billion yuan ($394.89 million) in a subsidiary of battery maker Sunwoda Electronic
, a stock exchange filing showed on Friday.
Li Auto will gain an 8.79% stake in the subsidiary, Sunwoda Power Technology, after the capital increase, Sunwoda said in the filing.
